These full-archive counts are the preserved supplied-source profile.  The v0.3 release
qualification above uses the real two-month City of London subset plus the complete LSOA
universe; it does not claim that the complete ~1.9M-row archive was re-ingested during this
specific debug-runtime release pass.

PERFORMANCE / DATA-SHAPE REPAIR
-------------------------------
The v0.2 category-shard writer scanned every LSOA for every category.  v0.3 instead:
1. discovers categories from existing frames;
2. opens one CsvStream per category;
3. walks existing frames once;
4. routes each non-zero category cell to its shard;
5. writes a CsvStream manifest with non-zero cell counts.

This changes the shard projection from an artificial category x period x full-area scan to
work proportional to existing non-zero category cells, while keeping CsvStream as the sole
CSV syntax authority.

SEMANTIC LOCKS
--------------
- stop/search is not recorded crime
- published street points are PUBLISHED_ANONYMISED
- police-published LSOA remains source evidence
- COUNT, RATE_PER_1000 and DENSITY_PER_KM2 are distinct metrics
- hotspot metric and peer population remain explicit
- short temporal windows remain evidence-graded
- spatial lag / neighbour patterns are statistical association, not offender movement
- geometry/topology remains NoSQLServer GIS authority
- public area analytics do not auto-attach to CriminalEnterprise / Person / Incident
- map frame is semantic; styling, mesh, camera and animation belong to the renderer

OPTIONAL FULL-SNAPSHOT TESTS
----------------------------
The following tests are retained for a complete derived national snapshot and are not part of
the self-contained core smoke pass:
- tests/full_snapshot_smoke.rex
- tests/full_change_map_smoke.rex
- tests/full_category_map_smoke.rex
- tests/trend_viewport_smoke.rex

The package intentionally excludes the large reproducible derived national snapshot.
